list.title: Available updates
list.empty: The system is up to date.
list.notChecked: No list yet: check for updates first.
list.noSecurityData: Without Alpine's security data (no network at the last check), no update is marked as a security update.

banner.new_release: Alpine {{ branch }} is available, supported until {{ date }}.
banner.next_release_ended: Alpine {{ branch }}, the next release after the installed one, reached its end of life on {{ date }}: this page offers no release upgrade from here. Upgrade one branch at a time by hand (see the Alpine release notes).
banner.newReleaseDiskless: Alpine {{ branch }} is available. A diskless or data mode system is upgraded with new boot media (setup-bootable -u and update-kernel; on a Raspberry Pi also the firmware at the root of the medium), not here.
banner.branch_eol: Alpine {{ branch }} reached its end of life on {{ date }} and gets no more updates.
banner.branch_eol_soon: Alpine {{ branch }} reaches its end of life on {{ date }}.
banner.repo_eol: The {{ repo }} repository of Alpine {{ branch }} has had no updates since {{ date }}.
banner.repo_eol_soon: The {{ repo }} repository of Alpine {{ branch }} gets updates only until {{ date }}.
banner.reboot: A restart is needed to use the new kernel.
banner.bootStale: Do NOT restart: the boot files of the new kernel are missing or older than the kernel. Check /boot first.

resume.mismatch: The release upgrade to {{ target }} is not finished: the repositories already point to {{ target }}. Do not restart now.
resume.partial: The release upgrade to {{ target }} stopped halfway. Do not restart now: resume it.
resume.interrupted: The release upgrade to {{ target }} was interrupted. Do not restart now: resume it.
resume.failed: Resuming the release upgrade to {{ target }} failed. Check the log, then try again.

resume.title: Resume the release upgrade
resume.message: Run apk update and the upgrade to {{ target }} again? The repositories stay as they are.

blocker.mode_not_sys: A release upgrade needs a system installed to disk (sys mode).
blocker.repos_inconsistent: The repositories do not all point to the installed release.
blocker.latest_stable_ahead: Lines with latest-stable would carry the upgrade past {{ target }}: point them to a branch first.
blocker.usr_separate: /usr is a separate mount, which Alpine 3.24 no longer supports.
blocker.boot_not_mounted: /boot is listed in /etc/fstab but not mounted.
blocker.extra_repos_mappable: A file in /etc/apk/repositories.d points to a release branch; edelweiss does not change those files.
blocker.repos_unavailable: apk could not use a repository of the target:
blocker.no_space_root: There is not enough free space on /.
blocker.no_space_boot: There is not enough free space on /boot.
blocker.simulation_failed: apk could not plan the upgrade.
blocker.apk_busy: Another apk runs ({{ name }}, pid {{ pid }}). Try again when it has finished.

warning.unmapped_repos: Some repository lines stay as they are (local paths, other repositories, testing, and lines with a tag such as @edge).
warning.latest_stable: Lines with latest-stable follow the newest release by themselves.
warning.grub_install: GRUB is installed: run grub-install yourself after the upgrade, before the restart.
warning.notes_3_24: Read the release notes of Alpine 3.24 first: /usr is merged, and GRUB must be installed again.

release.title: Release upgrade
release.target: Alpine {{ branch }} ({{ latest }}), supported until {{ eol }}
release.edgeWarning: edge is the development branch of Alpine: it changes daily and may break. There is no way back to a stable release.
release.noTargets: There is no newer release to upgrade to.
release.nextEnded: The next release after {{ current }} has reached its end of life: this page offers no release upgrade from here. Upgrade one branch at a time by hand (see the Alpine release notes).
release.noList: Alpine's release list is not available: check for updates with network access.

kind.resume: Resume the release upgrade to {{ target }}

steps.current-self-upgrade: Updating apk-tools of the current release

job.background: The job runs in the background: you may close this page or leave admin mode.
job.waiting: Waiting for another apk to finish …
job.waitingFor: Waiting for {{ name }} (pid {{ pid }}) to finish …
job.apkAlive: The job's runner is gone, but apk still runs (pid {{ pid }}). Wait until it has finished.
job.logAdminOnly: Turn on admin mode to see the log.

result.partial: The job finished with errors: some packages may not be upgraded.
result.partialRelease: The release upgrade stopped halfway. Do NOT restart: resume it.
result.failed_clean: The release upgrade failed before any package changed: the old repositories are back.
result.done_not_persisted: The packages changed, but lbu commit failed: the changes are lost on the next restart.
result.refreshPartial: Some repositories could not be checked: the list may be incomplete.
result.rebootNeeded: A restart is needed to use the new kernel.
result.dontReboot: Do NOT restart: the boot files of the new kernel are missing or old. Check /boot first.
result.updateKernel: A kernel or boot loader package changed: on a diskless or data mode system, update the boot medium with update-kernel.
result.grubBios: Replace /dev/sdX by the disk the system boots from.
result.stale: These processes still use replaced files; restart them when it suits you:

reboot.message: Restart {{ name }} now? All connections will be closed.
reboot.stillUp: The host still answers. The restart may take a while, or it did not happen.

errors.plan_expired: The preview is outdated: run it again.
errors.plan_blocked: The preview found problems that block this job.
errors.nothing_to_resume: There is no release upgrade to resume.
